brief: Miller frames current cyclicals strength as a 4Q2018 replay. Beta-adjusted hedge fund nets sit at 5-year lows yet High Beta Cyclicals (GSXUHBCY) are still up 12% year-to-date, because growth optimism has let the market rotate out of AI into ex-AI rather than price outright equity downside, while broad US AI (GSTMTAIP) is now negative on the year. If that now-mainstream growth-downgrade narrative keeps playing out, Goldman flags GSXUHBCY as a short candidate, noting it fell 23% versus SPX in 4Q2018 and now trades at a 40% premium to its 2018 trough multiple. If the selloff accelerates, the Conditional Downvar tail hedge (GSISCVS1), 2.5% above barrier and inside the corridor after today's 3.7% drop, is positioned for convex payoff. A reversal would instead exit the corridor and lock in delta-hedge losses. The preferred long offset is the High-versus-Low FCF pair. Separately, Goldman prefers Healthcare over Staples, launches a 2027 healthcare basket, stays long China High Dividends, and stays bearish China Competition as a value trap. Positioning is split: fast money is light, slow money is full.
